events.description: A person in a white-and-black striped shirt attacks another person seated on the floor on the right side of the cell; the attacker grabs, lifts, and throws the victim repeatedly over several seconds.

The victim on the right is seated or crouched and appears unable to effectively defend themselves while being struck and thrown by the attacker in the striped shirt, constituting abuse of a helpless individual.

A shirtless man in the center engages in sustained physical combat with multiple individuals seated on a bench against the left wall; the altercation involves repeated striking, grappling, and pushing, with at least two others actively involved or being struck during the sequence.

The shirtless man repeatedly strikes and overpowers individuals who are seated or falling, including one person in a white top who appears unable to effectively defend themselves and is pushed to the ground (e.g., f3–f5), indicating targeted aggression against a vulnerable party.

Two individuals engage in a sustained physical fight in the center of the holding cell: one shirtless man (orange torso) and another wearing dark shorts and a striped top. The fight involves grappling, punching, and throwing; at ~31.0s, the shirtless man is knocked to the floor and remains supine while the other stands over him briefly before stepping back.

After the shirtless man is on the ground (f14), the other combatant stands over him and appears to deliver at least one additional strike or stomp while the victim is incapacitated and lying motionless on the floor — consistent with abuse of a helpless person.

events.description: A shirtless man in black shorts attacks another individual seated on a bench near the left wall; the attacker grabs, lifts, and throws the victim to the floor.

A third person (wearing red headwear) enters the frame and engages with the shirtless attacker, leading to a brief physical struggle involving both individuals on the floor.

The shirtless man remains on the floor, seemingly incapacitated, while the newly arrived person in red appears to continue aggressive contact; simultaneously, a uniformed officer enters and begins intervening.
